name: congress
description: Number of the Congress, e.g. 115 for the 115th Congress (2017-2019)
observations: Ordinal Congress number, starting at 1 in 1789. Each Congress spans two years. Partition column of the partitioned tables

name: rollnumber
description: Sequential number of the roll call within the Congress and chamber
observations: Starts at 1 in the first roll call of each Congress. Excludes quorum calls and vacated votes, so it does not match clerk_rollnumber. Stored as text: cast to INT64 to sort numerically

name: date
observations: Not in the Voteview votes file. Added by Data Basis from the rollcalls table (congress, chamber, rollnumber)

name: icpsr
observations: In general one identifier per member for their whole career. Members who switched parties, and members who later became president, receive a new identifier so that a separate NOMINATE estimate can be produced. Use bioguide_id to identify the person

name: prob
description: Estimated probability, from NOMINATE (DW-NOMINATE) , of the member casting the vote as recorded
